parent_objective: run K=3/5/7 low-amplitude sequence diagnostic without changing thresholds or trust regions

public_gates: run K=3/5/7 sequence mining on M616 expanded source rows
keep actor training and PPO blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not widen action trust regions
do not claim optimizer admission before a later audit
hypothesis: Adding K=7 and intermediate low-amplitude steer deltas may recover additional source-diverse accepted sequences while preserving M621 trust regions and target thresholds.
success_criteria: summary records diagnostic_only true actor_parameters_changed false ppo_used false promoted false optimizer_admission false
accepted selected sequence diversity and accepted candidate diversity are reported
result is compared against M621 in the milestone doc

commands.name: longer_low_amplitude_mining
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.sequence_target_miner --checkpoint-policy bc5660=runs/m568_scaled_l3_bc_seed5660/checkpoint.pt --boundary-source-rows runs/m616_expanded_sequence_source_miner/expanded_sequence_source_rows.csv --surface-config fresh=configs/ppo_m541_matched_l3_variance_4096.json --surface-config ood=configs/eval_m574_moderate_ood_l3.json --sequence-lengths 3,5,7 --family constant_delta --family decay_pulse --family brake_release_then_steer --family steer_then_brake --steer-deltas=-0.08,-0.06,-0.04,0,0.04,0.06,0.08 --throttle-deltas=-0.06,0,0.03 --brake-deltas=-0.08,-0.04,0,0.04,0.08 --per-step-action-l2 0.10 --sequence-mean-l2-limit 0.08 --sequence-max-l2-limit 0.10 --max-delta-delta-l2-limit 0.08 --min-margin-improvement 0.02 --min-risk-improvement 0.05 --max-continuation-steps 80 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m624_longer_low_amplitude_sequence_miner

decision_rule: M624 passes if it runs the no-training K=7 diagnostic and records whether source-level accepted diversity improves over M621.
